name: OMaths
description: A collection of equations. Use the OMath object to access individual members of the collection.
remarks: Use the Add method to create an equation and add it to a document, selection, or range. The following example creates an equation and uses the BuildUp method of the OMath collection to convert the equation to professional format.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMaths object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMaths collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Linearize
methods.description: Converts all equations in the collection to linear format. .

methods.name: BuildUp
methods.description: Converts all equations in the collection to professional format.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates an equation, from the text equation contained within the specified range, and returns a Range object that contains the new equation.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies a range that contains a text equation.
